segments.text: It is ten at night. Your ceiling is coming down, and there is someone at your door you have never met.
You are entitled to know exactly who that is before you let them in.
{{COMPANY}} is a restoration contractor. Not a builder, not a cleaner, not a plumber.
The work starts the moment the damage stops spreading, and ends when your property is back to the condition it was in beforehand.
Every technician who attends carries photo identification and a certification you can verify.
You will be told their name before they arrive.
If anyone attends and cannot show you both, do not let them in. That applies to us as much as it applies to anybody else.
Call the number on this page to confirm any attendance.
